reuse.why: Replaces the three copied hidden-category queries with one new getFillableCategories selector used by every month-wide action; there was no existing helper for saved templates to reuse.

duplication.why: Removes the copied queries, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden/group-hidden check alongside the new fillable-id lookup, so the hidden rule is still decided twice there.

placement.why: The selector and the template check live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and the new selection helper change.

maintainability.why: One function now defines which categories a month-wide action may write; the extra query plus leftover inline check in copyPreviousMonth is a small inconsistency.

one_place.where: getFillableCategories in budget/actions.ts, used by setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg and (via an id set) copyPreviousMonth, which still also keeps its pre-existing inline hidden check.
